ledger.x: 12 July 1718: the Banat of Temeswar is established in the wake of the Treaty of Passarowitz, on the former Ottoman Eyalet of Temeşvar (1552-1716).
1739: "the Treaty of Belgrade returned areas along the southern Danube bank to Ottoman control".
1751: Maria Theresa introduces civil administration in the north; "The southern parts were excluded and the Banatian Military Frontier was set up there."
6 June 1778: the province "abolished"; on 23 April 1779 it was incorporated into the Kingdom of Hungary and divided into the counties of Torontál, Temes and Krassó.

wars.name: Austro-Turkish War of 1737-1739
wars.outcome: The Treaty of Belgrade (1739) returned the areas along the southern Danube bank to Ottoman control.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier line; the Danube strip and the Carpathian side are approximate.
